title: SKT's Mobile Performance Pack [MPP]
description: [Also works on PC] Simple performance-focused modpacks designed for Android and IOS Minecraft Launcher (Pojav, Mojo, Zalith, Amethyst)
body:
![MPP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f90a4883d6391e5189f560e47a2dae5f10695afd.jpeg) ### ![Batas](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5c65545eff131020a7c59230e82c1ce6d9540d2_0.webp)
Klik untuk deskripsi Berbahasa Indonesia ### ⚠️⠄Penting!!! Atur renderer ke MobileGlues di pengaturan renderer dan profil instance. jika masih crash coba untuk menghapus Sodium, Sodium-Extra, Reese's Sodium Options. Sejak Minecraft Versi 26.2 Sodium dan semua mods yang membutuhkannya tidak akan ditambahkan karena masalah pada renderer. Jika kalian masih mengalami bug dan crash, laporkan pada [Social Media](https://bemarketplace.carrd.co) atau [Server Discord-ku](https://discord.gg/RZeSBqs97A) terlebih dahulu sebelum melaporkan terhadap Developer Mod dan Launcher. ### 📖⠄Deskripsi ModPack simpel yang di-fokuskan untuk meningkatkan performa Minecraft pada launcer Android dan IOS (Pojav, Mojo, Zalith, Amethyst) ### 📈⠄Perbandingan **Tanpa ModPack.**
Rata-rata 150 FPS
8 Chunk
Fast Graphic **Dengan ModPack.**
Rata-rata 400 FPS
8 Chunk
Fast Graphic *Di-tes pada perangkat handphone POCO M4 Pro 4g (8/256), Helio G96, Mali GPU, Tanpa ROOT* **Tanpa ModPack.**
Rata-rata 40 FPS
24 Chunk
Fast Graphic **Dengan ModPack.**
Rata-rata 130 FPS
24 Chunks
Fast Graphic *Di-tes pada perangkat handphone POCO F7 (2/512), Snapdragon 8s Gen 4, Adreno 825, Tanpa ROOT* **Perangkat yang berbeda mungkin memberikan hasil yang berbeda. ### 💯⠄Rekomendasi • Gunakan **Java Arguments** untuk mengurangi stuttering dan meningkatkan efisiensi memori.
Coba menggunakan Ini -Xmx4G -Xms4G -XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:SoftMaxHeapSize=1G -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch
**Hapus Java Argument terlebih dahulu setiap kali kalian menginstal Mod Loader/ModPack • Nyalakan **V-sync, Sustained Performance Mode & Alternative Surface Rendering** pada pengaturan launcher, bukan pada pengaturan Minecraft. • Pada menu pengaturan Minecraft atur **Maximum FPS** kalian sesuai dengan Refresh Rate layar kalian, lalu ditambahkan 10. Contoh, Untuk layar 60Hz, Atur menjadi 70 FPS. ### 🚨⠄Lapor Bug & Saran Gabung ke Discord serverku > [SKT x SenkuMC Enchanters](https://discord.gg/RZeSBqs97A) Saluran WhatsApp Khusus Berbahasa Indonesia > [Klik Untuk Bergabung](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029Vb7Qh4d89incrkIPAP2M)
### ⚠️⠄Important!!! Set renderer to MobileGlues on renderer settings or instance profile settings. if it doesn't work, try remove Sodium, Sodium-Extra, Reese's Sodium Options. Since Minecraft version 26.2 Sodium and any mods that depend on it wouldn't be included due to renderer incompatibility. If you still encounter any crash or bug, report on my [Social Media](https://bemarketplace.carrd.co ) or [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/RZeSBqs97A) first before reporting to the Mods or Launcher Developer. ### 📖⠄Description Simple performance-focused modpacks designed for Android and IOS Minecraft Launcher (Pojav, Mojo, Zalith, Amethyst) ### 📈⠄Comparison **Without ModPack.**
150 FPS Average
8 Chunks
Fast Graphic **With ModPack.**
400 FPS Average
8 Chunks
Fast Graphic *Tested on POCO M4 Pro 4g (8/256), Helio G96, Mali GPU, Without ROOT* **Without ModPack.**
40 FPS Average
24 Chunks
Fast Graphic **With ModPack.**
130 FPS Average
24 Chunks
Fast Graphic *Tested on POCO F7 (2/512), Snapdragon 8s Gen 4, Adreno 825, Without ROOT* **Different devices might get different results ### 💯⠄Recommendation • Use **Java Arguments** for reducing stuttering and improve garbage collection.
Try using this -Xmx4G -Xms4G -XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational -XX:SoftMaxHeapSize=1G -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch
**Remove Java Argument first every time you install Mod Loader/ModPack • Enable **V-sync, Sustained Performance Mode & Alternative Surface Rendering** on launcher settings, not on Minecraft settings. • Go to Minecraft settings and set your **Maximum FPS** to your screen’s refresh rate plus 10. For example, for a 60 Hz screen, set it to 70 FPS. ### 🚨⠄Bug Report & Suggestion Join my Discord server > [SKT x SenkuMC Enchanters](https://discord.gg/RZeSBqs97A) ### ![Batas](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5c65545eff131020a7c59230e82c1ce6d9540d2_0.webp) ### 👋🏼⠄Follow Me [![sosmed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16cc8f715524df9efac5b04aade8d340d512c1d9.jpeg)](https://bento.me/skt) ### ![Batas](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5c65545eff131020a7c59230e82c1ce6d9540d2_0.webp) ### 🤝🏼⠄Partner [![smchub](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/449a0f478001c085f260386eb494153e53b3a77b.jpeg)](https://bento.me/smchub)
